settings.custom_liquid: <style>.msc-learn-page[data-msc-registry-id="MSC-HUB-BASICS"] .msc-learn-guide-card[data-msc-guide-id="MSC-GUIDE-001"].is-live-guide{cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s ease}.msc-learn-page[data-msc-registry-id="MSC-HUB-BASICS"] .msc-learn-guide-card[data-msc-guide-id="MSC-GUIDE-001"].is-live-guide:hover,.msc-learn-page[data-msc-registry-id="MSC-HUB-BASICS"] .msc-learn-guide-card[data-msc-guide-id="MSC-GUIDE-001"].is-live-guide:focus-within{border-color:rgba(212,190,153,.82)}.msc-learn-guide-card__link-cover{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;border-radius:inherit;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;outline:none}</style><script>(() => { const page = document.querySelector('.msc-learn-page[data-msc-registry-id="MSC-HUB-BASICS"]'); const card = page ? page.querySelector('.msc-learn-guide-card[data-msc-guide-id="MSC-GUIDE-001"]') : null; if (!card || card.querySelector('.msc-learn-guide-card__link-cover')) return; card.removeAttribute('aria-disabled'); card.classList.add('is-live-guide'); const note = card.querySelector('.msc-learn-preview-note'); if (note) note.remove(); const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = '/pages/learn-bitcoin-basics?view=msc-learn-guide'; link.className = 'msc-learn-guide-card__link-cover'; link.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Read What Is Bitcoin?'); const label = document.createElement('span'); label.className = 'visually-hidden'; label.textContent = 'Read What Is Bitcoin?'; link.appendChild(label); card.appendChild(link); })();</script>
